scenes.description: Tyler stands in the corner of the waiting room, clutching an agenda filled with notes, looking slightly nervous. The room is quiet, with a few other families preparing for the upcoming baptism. Zak and Mrs. Delgado, the child's mother, are nearby, offering quiet support and encouragement.

characters.name: Tyler Chavez
characters.description: 27-year-old young professional, first-time godfather, reserved and self-doubting but determined and thoughtful.; 27-year-old, Male, Community Role, 24 years old; Occupation: Young Professional; Personality: Reserved, Self-doubting, Determined, Thoughtful; Values: Responsibility, Growth, Community; Interests: Personal Development, Religious Traditions, Helping Others; Experiences: First time serving as a godfather, Transitioning into adulthood, Coping with social expectations
characters.states: Nervous, clutching agenda, looking out of place

characters.name: Zak Delgado
characters.description: Friendly, experienced godfather and father of the child being baptized; Male; Age: 42; Occupation: High school history teacher; Personality: Compassionate, patient, composed; Values: Family, tradition, integrity; Interests: Classic literature, gardening, quiet family dinners; Experiences: Married for 15 years with two children, served as a godparent multiple times, actively involved in his children's religious upbringing.
characters.states: Calm, reassuring, handing Tyler the baptismal robe

characters.name: Mrs. Delgado
characters.description: Mrs. Delgado, the mother of the child being baptized, is warm and grateful for Tyler's involvement; Female; Age: 42; Occupation: School Counselor; Personality: Compassionate, composed, observant; Values: Family, faith, community service; Interests: Volunteering at the church, reading spiritual literature, gardening; Experiences: Organized multiple community outreach programs, recently went through a personal spiritual renewal, has three children all involved in church activities.
characters.states: Nodding with appreciation, watching Tyler closely

actions.dialogue: I hope I'm doing this right... I don't really know what to expect.
You're doing great, Tyler. Just be there for him, and that's all that matters.
Thank you for stepping up, Tyler. It means a lot to us.

scenes.plot: Tyler is preparing for his first baptism as a godfather and is feeling the weight of responsibility. Zak, a more experienced godfather, reassures him while Mrs. Delgado expresses her gratitude for his involvement. Tyler's internal conflict between his self-doubt and his desire to grow is evident in his actions and dialogue.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Tyler's personal growth and the social expectations placed on him as a godfather, while showing how community support can help him navigate these challenges.
